attempts.summary: Formed a 3-node RabbitMQ cluster (node1, node2, node3) on Ubuntu 24.04 using the distro's rabbitmq-server 3.12.1 package, with a shared Erlang cookie distributed via secret_env. Created the `payments` vhost and an `app_user` account with full permissions on it, plus a durable `orders` quorum queue replicated across all 3 nodes. Verified messages published to the queue survived a simulated loss of one node (node3 stopped) and remained consumable from node1/node2. Restored node3 and confirmed full quorum recovery. Then, per the mandatory restart protocol, sequentially rebooted node1, node2, and node3 (one at a time, preserving quorum), proved each node's boot ID changed, and confirmed RabbitMQ, cluster membership, and the quorum queue fully recovered on each node — finishing with a live publish/consume round-trip as app_user in the payments vhost.
